invariant: EntityImageEmptyPackage resolves classDiagram.package.title and stores its RoundCorner diameter in Fashion before ClusterDecoration selects the concrete painter. An unknown packageStyle such as `stack` falls back to PackageStyle.FOLDER in SkinParam, so the resulting USymbolFolder must consume the package-title diameter. USymbolFolder uses a polygon only when the diameter is zero; otherwise every body corner has radius diameter/2 and the tab shoulder uses radius 1.5 times that radius.
causal_divergence: Rust now resolves and stores the correct package-title diameter in EmptyPackageLayout, but emit_layout_empty_symbol_folder_shape still hardcodes the default 2.5 and 3.75 radii. The preserved packageStyle checker therefore has the correct semantic fallback to a folder but paints the wrong Fashion geometry.
planned_change: Pass EmptyPackageLayout.round_corner into the empty folder/package path equations, including Java's zero-diameter polygon branch and nonzero tab/body arcs. Preserve PackageStyle's supported-value set and unknown-value fallback; do not add `stack` as a supported packageStyle. Apply the same resolved package-title value to ordinary empty-package folder rendering where it shares EntityImageEmptyPackage ownership.
